details.ask: Table reservation for 15 and guarantee of a good table

reason: The high-demand date requires owner review and the message contains a complaint.
draft_reply: DRAFT FOR OWNER APPROVAL: Thank you for contacting us. I have forwarded your message regarding your friend's visit and your inquiry about a table for 15 on October 24, 2026, directly to ownership and management for review and follow-up.
message:
TEST DATA — written by our team: A guest says their friend got sick after eating the wings and nobody helped. They also want a table for 15 on Saturday, October 24, 2026. Can you guarantee a good table?

Keep the received date as today,
